email.subject: Quick fix for Saltwater Group's site
email.body:
Hi Priya,

I checked Saltwater Group Hair Studio's website. Two things are likely costing you bookings: it isn't mobile-friendly, so most people searching on their phone struggle to even view it, and there's no click-to-call button, so they can't tap to ring the salon directly. Between those two, you're probably losing calls every week from people who just give up and try someone else.

I also noticed no listed hours and no reviews showing, which doesn't help trust either.

I fix local business sites for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough of what I'd change?

Alex
